subject.title: Agent confabulates completed actions on Telegram surface — same config works reliably on Claude Code/Codex

question: Should #41824 be resolved through a plugin/ClawHub claim verifier using existing hooks, or does OpenClaw core need a narrow new hook/correlation guarantee for Telegram/source-channel unsupported success claims?
rationale: The remaining behavior spans Telegram delivery, agent runtime state, and optional policy enforcement; #68051 already set broad claim verification as plugin scope, but #41824 may still expose a core hook-correlation gap.

options.title: Keep Verification In Plugins
options.body: Core keeps delivery invariants narrow and claim verification ships as a plugin or ClawHub package, with only documented hook/API gaps promoted back to core.

options.title: Add A Narrow Core Seam
options.body: Core adds the smallest missing run/delivery correlation or hook contract needed for verifier plugins to be reliable without owning verifier policy.

options.title: Promote Core Claim Verification
options.body: Core implements a built-in side-effect claim ledger and warn/strict behavior, accepting a new compatibility-sensitive policy surface.

recommendation.title: Keep Verification In Plugins
recommendation.body: Core keeps delivery invariants narrow and claim verification ships as a plugin or ClawHub package, with only documented hook/API gaps promoted back to core.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete made the closest recorded product-boundary decision on #68051 and is the strongest owner signal for whether this stays plugin-scoped or becomes core policy.
